name: Nicholas Gunner
tagline: Specialty-crop farmer and agricultural technologist. Owner/operator of Gunner Gardens, a diversified U-pick flower, fruit, and honey farm; PhD researcher in agricultural AI and robotics at Cornell AgriTech; and lead developer of the Every.Farm (formerly My Efficient Vineyard) precision-agriculture platform.
